title: Godot 4.7 overwrites editor_settings resource file with default values in headless mode
body:
### Tested versions

I only tried in v4.7.beta2.official [777579205] so far.
Did not happen in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935] or v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e].

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta2 - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS - AuthenticAMD AMD EPYC 9354P 32-Core Processor - 15Gb RAM

### Issue description

I'm running a CI job on a Ubuntu VPS. Everything is running headless.

After upgrading from 4.6 to 4.7 the information from the `editor_settings-4.6.tres` file has not been migrated to `editor_settings-4.7.tres`.  When I tried to edit the file manually to set paths to java and android sdks, I noticed the file being overwritten each time godot is run. Making it impossible to create Android builds using CI.

This doesn't seem to happen on my desktop, where I am able to run the GUI.

~~I'm also encountering an issue of files being always fully re-imported regardless of anything in the `.godot` directory on each run in the CI job. This might be related, I'm trying to investigate more.~~

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make sure any godot config/cache files are cleared.
2. Import godot project in headless mode (`godot --headless --editor --quit`)
3. This will create the `editor_settings-4.7.tres` file.
4. Edit the file.
5. Re-run the edtior in headless mode.
6. The file will be overwritten.
